MacroName wizard_imageshift

##################DO NOT EDIT ANYTHING IN THIS SCRIPT!#############
# Name: wizard_imageshift
# Author: Simon Fromm
# Version: 1.0.1
# SerialEM version: 4.2.X or higher
# Last update: 29.06.2026
# Support: simon.fromm@embl.de
# DOES NOT WORK AS STANDALONE. Needs to be called via the LowDoseWizard script
###################################################################

SuppressReports

Echo
Echo +++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++
Echo Starting LowDoseWizard IMAGE SHIFT routine
Echo +++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++
Echo

#################################################
# Read in optics config file
#################################################

ReportSystemPath
ReadStringsFromFile optics $repVal1\wizard_optics_config.txt
CallStringArray optics

#################################################
# Check that Record C2 aperture is inserted
#################################################

IsVariableDefined c2apR
If $repVal1 == 0
   IsVariableDefined C2apertureR
   If $repVal1 == 0
      GoToLowDoseArea R
      ReportMag
      magR := $repVal1
      c2apR := $C2apertureR_$magR
   Else
      c2apR := $C2apertureR
   Endif
Endif
ReportApertureSize 1
If $repVal1 != $c2apR
   SetApertureSize 1 $c2apR
   Echo Inserted $c2apR micron C2 aperture.
Endif

#################################################
# Set area for image shift calibration
#################################################

MoveToNavItem $sample

# Reset old IS offsets
SetLowDoseShiftOffset 0 0 0
SetLowDoseShiftOffset 1 0 0

# Take a view image to check if one gets a suitable image for eucentricity and refine if necessary
SetColumnOrGunValve 1
V

YesNoBox Is the current image/area suitable for finding eucentricity?
If $repVal1 == 0
   CallFunction drag_V
   ChangeItemLabel $sample sample_old
   ReportStageXYZ
   AddStagePosAsNavPoint $repVal1 $repVal2 $repVal3
   ReportOtherItem -1
   sample := $repVal1
   ChangeItemLabel $sample sample
Endif

# Reset the Focus position
SetAxisPosition F 0

# Find Eucentricity
CallFunction ZwithV
CallFunction ZwithG
UpdateItemZ $sample
MoveToNavItem $sample

# Take a view image to check for features for finding image shift offsets
V

YesNoBox Does the image contain features suitable for image shift offset calibration (e.g. some contamination, membranes or foil hole edge)?
If $repVal1 == 0
   CallFunction drag_V
Endif

# Refine the position for the actual calibration with Preview
GoToLowDoseArea R
ScreenDown
OKBox Please center the beam with DIRECT ALIGNMENTS --> Tomo Beam shift; Then click OK to continue
ScreenUp
SetDefocus -2
L

YesNoBox Does the image contain features suitable for image shift offset calibration (e.g. some contamination, membranes or foil hole edge)?
If $repVal1 == 0
   CallFunction drag_P
Endif

IsVariableDefined c2apR
If $repVal1 == 0
   ReportApertureSize 1
   c2apR = $repVal1
Endif

#################################################
# Image shift offset calibration
#################################################

OKBox Image shift offsets will now be found using an automated routine. This can produce incorrect results, \
so please follow the routine on the screen. If shifts above the threshold ($MaxISOffsetV um for View, $MaxISOffsetS um for Search) are detected, you will be given the choice to redo the routine at a new area.

# View
FindLowDoseShiftOffset 0
ReportLDShiftOffset 0
x-shift = $repVal1
y-shift = $repVal2
x-shift_abs = ABS $x-shift
y-shift_abs = ABS $y-shift
x-shift_view = ROUND $x-shift 2
y-shift_view = ROUND $y-shift 2

shift-view = { $x-shift_abs $y-shift_abs }
ArrayStatistics shift-view
If $repVal3 > $MaxISOffsetV
   Echo
   Echo WARNING: Determined View image shift offset is bigger than the threshold of $MaxISOffsetV um ($x-shift_view / $y-shift_view um in X/Y).
   Echo WARNING: Automatic View image shift offset calibration might have produced a wrong result.
   Echo
   ParseQuotedStrings 1
   header = { 'A shift offset larger than the set threshold ($MaxISOffsetV um) has been determined. Would you like to' }
   prompt1 = { '1: redo the procedure at a different area?' }
   prompt2 = { '2: keep the determined View offset and move on?' }
   prompt3 = { '3: reset the View offset to 0 and move on?' }
   buttons = { '1: Redo' '2: Keep' '3: Reset' }
   ThreeChoiceBox header prompt1 prompt2 prompt3 buttons
   ParseQuotedStrings 0
   If $repVal1 == 1
      SkipTo ViewRedo
   Elseif $repVal1 == 2
      Echo View shift offsets are kept as determined ($x-shift_view / $y-shift_view um).
      Echo NOTE: Those shifts are above the set system threshold ($MaxISOffsetV um).
      Echo
      SkipTo Search
   Elseif $repVal1 == 3
      Echo View shift offsets are reset to 0.
      Echo
      SetLowDoseShiftOffset 0 0 0
      SkipTo Search
   Endif
Else
   OKBox Determined View image shift offset is $x-shift_view / $y-shift_view um in X/Y.
   Echo
   Echo Determined View image shift offset is $x-shift_view / $y-shift_view um in X/Y.
   Echo
   SkipTo Search
Endif

# View redo
ViewRedo:
OKBox You have chosen to redo the View image shift offset calibration at a different area. A Search image is taken first to allow you to identify and move to an area with suitable features for image shift offset calibration.
SetLowDoseShiftOffset 0 0 0
Search
CallFunction drag_S
V
YesNoBox Does the new area contain features suitable for image shift offset calibration?
If $repVal1 == 0
   CallFunction drag_V
Endif
L
YesNoBox Does the image contain features suitable for image shift offset calibration (e.g. some contamination, membranes or foil hole edge)?
If $repVal1 == 0
   CallFunction drag_P
Endif
OKBox View image shift offest calibration is restarted now. Please follow the routine on the screen. \
If shifts above the threshold ($MaxISOffsetV um) are detected again, you will need to set image shift offsets manually after the LDW.
FindLowDoseShiftOffset 0
ReportLDShiftOffset 0
x-shift = $repVal1
y-shift = $repVal2
x-shift_abs = ABS $x-shift
y-shift_abs = ABS $y-shift
x-shift_view = ROUND $x-shift 2
y-shift_view = ROUND $y-shift 2

shift-view = { $x-shift_abs $y-shift_abs }
ArrayStatistics shift-view
If $repVal3 > $MaxISOffsetV
   Echo
   Echo WARNING: Determined View image shift offset is again bigger than the threshold of $MaxISOffsetV um ($x-shift_view / $y-shift_view um in X/Y).
   Echo NOTE: View image shift offset is reset to 0 and image shift offset routine aborted.
   Echo
   SetLowDoseShiftOffset 0 0 0
   OKBox Routine is aborted due to repeated View image shift offset determination above the threshold.
   SkipTo Finish
Else
   OKBox Determined View image shift offset is $x-shift_view / $y-shift_view um in X/Y.
   Echo
   Echo Determined View image shift offset is $x-shift_view / $y-shift_view um in X/Y.
   Echo
Endif

# Search
Search:

If $c2apR < 50
   OKBox Inserted C2 aperture is <50 micorns. The Search FOV might be cut off by the C2 aperture. This should be no problem.
Endif

GoToLowDoseArea V
ReportMag
magV := $repVal1
GoToLowDoseArea S
ReportMag
magS := $repVal1

If $magV == $magS
   ReportLDShiftOffset 0
   SetLowDoseShiftOffset 1 $repVal1 $repVal2
   Echo View and Search mags are identical. Determined View image shift offsets copied to Search.
   SkipTo Closing
Endif

If $EnergyFilter == 1
   ReportEnergyFilter
   If $repVal2 == $EslitOffsetS_plasmon
      tmpplasmon = 1
      Echo Search is setup for plasmon imaging. It will be temporarily set to ZLP imaging for finding image shift offsets.
      Echo After the routine, it will be set back to plasmon imaging.
      ReportEnergyFilter
      tmpwidth = $repVal1
      tmpoffset = $repVal2
      SetLDContinuousUpdate 1
      SetSlitWidth $EslitWidthS
      SetEnergyLoss $EslitOffsetS
      UpdateLowDoseParams S 1
      SetLDContinuousUpdate 0
   Else
      tmpplasmon = 0
   Endif
Else
   tmpplasmon = 0
Endif

FindLowDoseShiftOffset 1
ReportLDShiftOffset 1
x-shift = $repVal1
y-shift = $repVal2
x-shift_abs = ABS $x-shift
y-shift_abs = ABS $y-shift
x-shift_search = ROUND $x-shift 2
y-shift_search = ROUND $y-shift 2

shift-search = { $x-shift_abs $y-shift_abs }
ArrayStatistics shift-search
If $repVal3 > $MaxISOffsetS
   Echo
   Echo WARNING: Determined Search image shift offset is bigger than the threshold of $MaxISOffsetS um ($x-shift_search / $y-shift_search um in X/Y).
   Echo WARNING: Automatic Search image shift offset calibration might have produced a wrong result.
   Echo
   ParseQuotedStrings 1
   header = { 'A shift offset larger than the set threshold ($MaxISOffsetS um) has been determined. Would you like to' }
   prompt1 = { '1: redo the procedure at a different area?' }
   prompt2 = { '2: keep the determined Search offset and move on?' }
   prompt3 = { '3: reset the Search offset to 0 and move on?' }
   buttons = { '1: Redo' '2: Keep' '3: Reset' }
   ThreeChoiceBox header prompt1 prompt2 prompt3 buttons
   ParseQuotedStrings 0
   If $repVal1 == 1
      SkipTo SearchRedo
   Elseif $repVal1 == 2
      Echo Search shift offsets are kept as determined ($x-shift_search / $y-shift_search um).
      Echo NOTE: Those shifts are above the set system threshold ($MaxISOffsetS um).
      Echo
      search_fail = 1
      SkipTo PlasmonReset
   Elseif $repVal1 == 3
      Echo Search shift offsets are reset to 0.
      Echo NOTE: Previously determined View shift offset is kept.
      Echo
      SetLowDoseShiftOffset 1 0 0
      search_fail = 1
      SkipTo PlasmonReset
   Endif
Else
   OKBox Determined Search image shift offset is $x-shift_search / $y-shift_search um in X/Y.
   Echo
   Echo Determined Search image shift offset is $x-shift_search / $y-shift_search um in X/Y.
   Echo
   SkipTo PlasmonReset
Endif

SearchRedo:
OKBox You have chosen to redo the Search image shift offset calibration at a different area. A Search image is taken first to allow you to identify and move to an area with suitable features for image shift offset calibration.
SetLowDoseShiftOffset 1 0 0
Search
CallFunction drag_S
V
YesNoBox Does the new area contain features suitable for image shift offset calibration?
If $repVal1 == 0
   CallFunction drag_V
Endif
OKBox Search image shift offest calibration is restarted now. Please follow the routine on the screen. \
If shifts above the threshold ($MaxISOffsetS um) are detected again, you will need to set Search image shift offsets manually after the LDW.
FindLowDoseShiftOffset 1
ReportLDShiftOffset 1
x-shift = $repVal1
y-shift = $repVal2
x-shift_abs = ABS $x-shift
y-shift_abs = ABS $y-shift
x-shift_search = ROUND $x-shift 2
y-shift_search = ROUND $y-shift 2

shift-search = { $x-shift_abs $y-shift_abs }
ArrayStatistics shift-search
If $repVal3 > $MaxISOffsetS
   Echo
   Echo WARNING: Determined Search image shift offset is again bigger than $MaxISOffsetS um ($x-shift_search / $y-shift_search um in X/Y).
   Echo Search image shift offset is reset to 0 and image shift offset routine aborted.
   Echo NOTE: Previously determined View shift offset is kept.
   Echo
   search_fail = 1
   OKBox Routine is aborted due to repeated Search image shift offset determination above the threshold.
   SkipTo PlasmonReset
Else
   OKBox Determined Search image shift offset is $x-shift_search / $y-shift_search um in X/Y.
   Echo
   Echo Determined Search image shift offset is $x-shift_search / $y-shift_search um in X/Y.
   Echo
Endif

PlasmonReset:

If $tmpplasmon == 1
   Echo Changing energy filter settings in Search back to plasmon imaging.
   Echo
   GoToLowDoseArea S
   SetLDContinuousUpdate 1
   SetSlitWidth $tmpwidth
   SetEnergyLoss $tmpoffset
   UpdateLowDoseParams S 1
   SetLDContinuousUpdate 0
   IsVariableDefined search_fail
   If $repVal1 == 1
      SkipTo Finish
   Endif
Else
   IsVariableDefined search_fail
   If $repVal1 == 1
      SkipTo Finish
   Endif
Endif

Closing:

#################################################
# Closing message
#################################################

OKBox Completed LowDoseWizard IMAGE SHIFT routine. Image shift offsets have been calibrated.
Echo
Echo +++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++
Echo Completed LowDoseWizard IMAGE SHIFT routine.
Echo Image shift offsets have been calibrated.
Echo +++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++
Echo
Finish:
GoToLowDoseArea R
